title: Fresh Scoped Approval for Two-Commit Clearance Path
summary: Prepare a fresh scoped approval packet for the FP-MCP-223 request after FP-MCP-225 clarified the two-commit policy and FP-MCP-226 implemented observer support. This checkpoint records preparation only. The approval recorder remains backward-compatible with a single repoCommit field, so the approval evidence should bind repoCommit to the request execution base commit 6fb3a32, while the later operator-local clearance artifact should carry both executionBaseCommit 6fb3a32 and requestArtifactCommit dccc41c/current HEAD or later exact evidence HEAD. This checkpoint does not create local clearance, consume approval, clear the disable switch, contact runner start, start OpenCode, or run FP-027.
caveats: The structured approval recorder currently exposes one repoCommit field, not a first-class two-commit tuple.
The approval repoCommit should remain compatible with the request artifact execution base commit 6fb3a32.
The later operator-local clearance artifact must include executionBaseCommit and requestArtifactCommit to satisfy the FP-MCP-226 observer policy.
Any later evidence commit may advance HEAD again; the local clearance requestArtifactCommit must match the exact HEAD observed at clearance time.
This checkpoint does not create or mutate local clearance.

freshApprovalScope.approvalRepoCommitMeaning: executionBaseCommit for backward-compatible structured approval recorder

currentTwoCommitPolicy.requestArtifactCommitMeaning: exact committed evidence state used by the FP-MCP-226 observer call; must be refreshed if HEAD advances before local clearance
